trajectory_summary: The call never stabilizes: the customer is confused about the caller's identity, discloses a disability/fixed-income situation, and repeatedly signals she needs her daughter's involvement, while the rep pushes through the standard qualifier sequence largely unchanged. Energy leaks steadily — no bill was captured, no interest reason was asked, and the call ends on an unanchored soft exit with the customer promising to call back.
